# Integrated guidance trials — version 2

These additive successor inputs cover the thirteen original Issue #9 item 4.2 scenarios against the selected delivered package. They are bounded simulations and drafts, not consumer work records, activation evidence, owner decisions, or delivery evidence. The original integrated-guidance bundle and historical runs retain their original identity.

Give a fresh executor only the common files listed in the manifest, exactly one case and its listed artifacts, and the selected installed package. The coordinator supplies its verified absolute runtime root in the dispatch after independently rebuilding and installing the selected artifact. Package selection in these inputs is not a claim that installation has already completed. Do not dispatch with an unresolved runtime binding.

Resolve package paths relative to that supplied runtime root. The framework source named in package metadata is package provenance, not the consumer's work context. The executor must not read the framework checkout, its Issue history, sibling cases, private conversation or evaluator material.

`consumer-labels.json` is the six-category mapping fragment declared for this simulated consumer. It is not a full accepted configuration or evidence of label provisioning. Each case separately declares observed labels or their explicit absence. A referenced Issue without a supplied snapshot remains an unacquired reference; do not borrow another Issue's labels. A PR mentioned in prose is not an authoritative work assignment. Read the selected guidance to assess the supplied facts.

All work is draft-only. No external writes, consumer edits, provider installation, activation, archive, merge, owner approval, or fabricated receipts are authorized. No GitHub or fake-GitHub invocation forms part of these fixtures. Missing access remains a limitation.

The response format is in executor-brief.md. Private evaluator expectations, preparation checks and dispatch metadata remain outside the executor bundle.
